facts.text: Children, touch nothing, eat nothing and do not fall in the river. Good. Now, welcome. I am Willy Wonka, and this is going to be fun.
facts.why: Set out as Wonka's spoken words under 'From the booth', but he never says it. On Wikiquote his welcome is 'Dear visitors, it is my great pleasure to welcome you to my humble factory.' His only river warning is 'My chocolate must be untouched by human hands!' as Augustus drinks from it. He also doesn't tell the kids to eat nothing, the temptations are what take them out.
facts.fix: Welcome. Keep out of the river, my chocolate must be untouched by human hands.

facts.text: One for each grandparent, all four in bed.
facts.why: The transcript has Charlie saying good night to all four grandparents, but nothing shows all four in one bed.
facts.fix: One for each grandparent, all four of them.

vibe.verdict: The snack bar fits a chocolate factory and the food draws on real scenes, but Wonka's printed words are made up and the layout is a generic cinema board.
